type_text:
∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)).remaining = [] ∧
          ∀ (a : ℕ),
            n * labels.length ≤ a →
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer a =
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)
